scenes.title: Al-Balad Balconies
scenes.brief: Old Jeddah street with wooden rawashin balconies and cats

character.description: A Jeddah street cat on a windowsill; a girl below in a Hijazi tulle dress and gold headscarf

scenes.title: King Fahd's Fountain
scenes.brief: Kids on the Corniche watching King Fahd's Fountain and boats

character.description: A boy in a T-shirt and shorts with a scooter waving at the fountain

scenes.title: Red Sea Reef
scenes.brief: Snorkelers above a Red Sea coral reef full of fish

character.description: A hawksbill sea turtle gliding past a clownfish; snorkelers in wetsuits above

scenes.title: Fish Market
scenes.brief: Morning fish market with fishermen and seagulls

character.description: A fisherman in a sarong-style izar and white skullcap holding a big hamour

scenes.title: Corniche Sculptures
scenes.brief: Playing among the giant sculptures of the Corniche

character.description: Children in casual clothes playing hide and seek around the giant bike sculpture

scenes.title: Dhow at Sunset
scenes.brief: Traditional dhow sailing past the city at sunset

character.description: A sailor in a Hijazi sidriya vest, izar and turban at the dhow tiller

scenes.title: Hijazi Wedding
scenes.brief: Hijazi wedding with mizmar dancers and lanterns

character.description: Mizmar dancers in white thobes with embroidered vests and headwraps twirling sticks

scenes.title: Floating Mosque
scenes.brief: Floating Mosque by the sea with pelicans

character.description: A pelican landing on the pier beside a family in modern thobe and abaya
